checks.name: explicit preparation and consent precede server acquisition; double click opens one wallet request with the reviewed body
wallet rejection requires another explicit consent and acquisition of the same unchanged intent
uncertain submission and refresh preserve recovery without another wallet send
wallet account or network changes clear consent and wrong contexts cannot acquire a transaction
wallet change during server acquisition retains the acquired intent without opening a stale wallet request
private identity review link survives status polling and manual refresh without opening a wallet

scope: Minimal DOM/VM and scripted browser-provider/HTTP fixtures; no browser extension, public RPC, wallet signing or real transaction is used.
